metadata.description: Claude Code mods by nahuel893: openskin, an OpenCode-style look for the transcript; command-register, copy the shell commands Claude gives from a numbered list; board, a done, pending and waiting list per session; summarize, a short summary of the session on demand.

plugins.name: openskin
plugins.description: An OpenCode-style look for the Claude Code transcript, with framed shell commands; every color configurable.

plugins.name: command-register
plugins.description: A register of the shell commands Claude gives: /cc opens a panel to browse them message by message and copy one.

plugins.name: board
plugins.description: A living board per session: Claude keeps the list of what is done, pending and waiting on your decision with a board tool, and /board rewrites it from the conversation.

plugins.name: summarize
plugins.description: A summary of the session on demand: /summ writes the goal, what happened, the decisions and where things stand.
